summary.text: Mandy Lindsay, a Democrat, represents District 42 (Arapahoe County) in the Colorado House of Representatives, where the General Assembly lists her as Majority Caucus Co-Chair.

paragraphs.text: She has held the seat since January 2022, succeeding Dominique Jackson.
She was born in Denver and attended Tulane University.
Her career experience includes working in government and running a small business as a professional organizer.
